knownIssue.summary: HypNative.transferRemote on Sentrix Testnet reverts at 27k gas on broadcast ONLY when msg.value > 0. Calls with msg.value=0 succeed cleanly. eth_call and eth_estimateGas both succeed for the value-bearing case (state-dependent broadcast vs simulation divergence).
evidence: transferRemote(amount=0, value=0)   → status=1 gasUsed=86266 (block confirmed, 4 logs incl. Dispatch)
eth_sendRawTransaction (value=1e15) → reverts at 27k gas, no logs
knownIssue.isolatedTo: Sentrix EVM (revm 37) value-bearing transaction execution for payable functions with internal-call chains. Same call succeeds when msg.value=0.
knownIssue.reproducer: Deploy any Hyperlane HypNative + call transferRemote with msg.value > 0. Reverts at ~27k gas. Same call with msg.value=0 succeeds.
knownIssue.filedAs: TODO: open issue at sentrix-labs/sentrix repo titled 'EVM: payable internal-call chain reverts at 27k gas when msg.value > 0, while eth_call succeeds (Hyperlane HypNative.transferRemote repro)'
workarounds: Skip HypNative entirely — deploy HypERC20Collateral on Sentrix wrapping the existing canonical-contracts WSRX (Wrapped SRX) ERC20. Users wrap SRX → wSRX via WSRX9 first, then approve+transferRemote on the ERC20 path (no msg.value needed).
Workaround proves bridge concept tonight while the EVM bug is fixed in parallel.
Once the EVM bug is patched in sentrix-labs/sentrix, the native HypNative path becomes available without WSRX wrapping.
